description: This Java source file defines a class 'RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder' which provides a fluent API for constructing 'DittoHeaders' within the context of an HTTP request processing pipeline. It includes nested builder classes for setting initial headers, request context, query parameters, and finalizing the construction into a 'CompletionStage' that produces 'DittoHeaders' while ensuring size constraints and handling custom headers.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder
classes.description: A final class providing a fluent API to assemble 'DittoHeaders' in a stepwise manner, managing headers, request context, query parameters, and size constraints for HTTP request handling.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.RequestContextStep
classes.description: A nested class facilitating the step of setting the HTTP RequestContext which contains original request headers.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.QueryParametersStep
classes.description: A nested class for setting query parameters from the original request, converting them into headers, and checking for conflicts.

classes.name: RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder.BuildStep
classes.description: A nested class responsible for producing a CompletionStage that supplies the final 'DittoHeaders' object, applying custom headers and size checks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of 'RootRouteHeadersStepBuilder' with provided header translator, parameter mappings, custom header handler, and size checker.

methods.name: withInitialDittoHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Starts the building process with an initial 'DittoHeadersBuilder', returning the first builder step.
